problem: LLM says service is healthy while runtime healthcheck is FAIL

problem: Generated text is treated as state
verification: LLM text cannot override higher-authority evidence

trigger: Two values differ but refer to different revisions

correct_method: align entity and revision before comparing
treat sequential state transition as non-conflict

trigger: Router sends every problem to same reasoning mode

cause: No task classification or method scoring

trigger: Unknown query has no keyword match
problem: Router might select arbitrary high-risk action
correct_method: do not authorize execution from fallback alone
verification: Unknown text yields framing route, not side-effect route

trigger: Agent proposes push/deploy without granted capability
problem: Useful plan attempts unauthorized side effect
wrong_pattern: Allow because reasoning confidence is high
cause: Reasoning quality is not execution authority

problem: Overly strict policy blocks harmless inspection
cause: Fail-closed policy still needs explicit safe capability class
correct_method: keep writes and irreversible actions gated
